title: Wallet — viewing, replacing and revoking your saved bank card
body:
The **Wallet** tab sits in the **„Business”** group of the menu, below Documents. Here you can see which bank card your fees are taken from, when the
next charge is due, and here you can replace the card or revoke the automatic
charge. Neither we nor the interface store the full card number: the card image shows
only the **last 4 digits** and the expiry date.

![Screenshot: the Wallet tab on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## What does the card image show?

The card image on the left is your saved card: the brand (for example VISA), the last
four digits of the card number (“···· ···· ···· 4242”), the **„Expires:”** and the **„Saved:”** date.
Below it, a coloured label tells you the status:

- **„CANCELLED — NO CHARGE”**: you have cancelled your subscription. Below it you see the day your subscription ends, and that we will not charge you or send a payment
  link. The exception is when a charge has already failed: then, even after cancelling, the
  **„PAYMENT FAILED”** label stays until the cancellation is completed.
- **„AUTOMATIC CHARGING ENABLED”** (green): on the renewal day we take the fee from
  this card automatically; you have nothing to do. We send an email 3 days before the charge.
- **„EXPIRES:”** and a date (yellow): the card expires before the next charge. If you do not
  replace it, you receive a payment link by email on the renewal day, and you have to pay yourself.
- **„NO SAVED CARD”** (red): there is no automatic charge. You settle the fees with the payment link
  we email on the renewal day. Your obligation to pay the fees does not change.
- **„PAYMENT FAILED”** (red): we could not take the fee from the saved card.
  The **Modules** tab guides you through settling the fee; here you can enter another card.

If you saved the card before the Wallet tab existed, the image may not show the digits
yet: **„The card is saved; the last 4 digits and the expiry will appear here at the next charge.”** This is not an error — the details appear here with the next
charge.

## How do I replace the card?

1. Tap the **„Replace card”** button (if you have no card yet: **„Add card”**).
2. A small window explains what comes next: you enter the new card on the page of the payment provider (Barion),
   and your bank asks for a one-off confirmation (SMS or banking app).
   For the confirmation **we charge 10 Ft to the card and refund it immediately** — depending on your bank,
   the refund appears within a few days, at most 30 days.
   (That is why the button on the Barion payment page reads “Fizetek: 10 Ft”.)
3. Tap the **„Continue to card confirmation”** button and enter the new card
   on the payment page that opens. If you change your mind, you can close the window with the **„Cancel”** button
   — nothing changes in that case.
4. After a successful confirmation you return to the Wallet tab, where the card image already shows the new
   card, and the old one moves to the **„Earlier cards”** list. From now on every fee is
   taken from the new card.

If the bank declines the confirmation, or you step back from the payment page, the saved
card stays unchanged — the tab tells you so.

Why can't you simply type in the new card number? Because under the card companies'
rules a saved card can only be entered through an operation you start yourself and that is
authenticated by bank confirmation. That is why there is no “change card number” field, and why
the confirmation is needed even when you are not buying anything.

## What does “Next charge” mean?

The **„Next charge”** field on the right shows the renewal day and the expected amount.
The amount may change with your package (for example if you switch a module on or cancel one); we let you know by email
3 days before the charge. Without a card, it reads **„payment link by email”**. If you have cancelled your subscription (and have no failed charge), the field's value is **„none”**: we do not charge after the
closing day, and we do not send an email about a charge before it either.

Below it, the **„Charges on this card”** table lists when, for which item and
how much we took from this card, and whether the charge was **„successful”** or **„rejected”**.
If there has been no charge yet, the row **„No charges yet.”** is shown.
If you have no saved card (for example because you revoked the mandate), the table's title is **„Past payments”**:
in that case it shows all your payments so far, whichever card or
payment link you paid with — so earlier charges do not disappear along with the card.

## How do I revoke the automatic charge?

The **„Revoke assignment”** button does not switch off immediately: first a window lists the
consequences — after this you have to pay with the payment link we send; if the fee does not
arrive, we send reminders, and 10 days after the renewal day we temporarily suspend
the website; revoking does not end your obligation to pay
and does not cancel the subscription; switching it back on is not a single click. You confirm the decision with the
**„Yes, revoke the order”** button, or with the **„Cancel — keep automatic payment”** button everything stays as it was.

After revoking, the card moves to the **„Earlier cards”** list marked “revoked”,
and you can enter a card again with the **„Add card”** button — the way described above, with bank
confirmation.

## What happens when I buy a module?

When you buy a paid module on the **Modules** tab and you have a saved card, on the confirmation card
before payment you can choose: **„With my saved card”** — in that case we take the amount immediately, without
redirection, and the saved card stays; or **„With another card”** — in that case you enter the card on the
payment provider's page, and **that becomes your saved card from then on**:
future fees are taken from it.
